notes.title: Update to version 0.8.102
notes.content:
Works been tough, we lost half a dozen people and I'm pulling 60 hours lately. Doing the best I can to keep pace with the game, but these updates will probably be a little smaller for a while. Thanks to everyone for their patience and support, each update makes the game a little better, and a little closer to being finished!

[list]
[*]Directional compass added that points to the nearest mission objective (if there is one), can be disabled in the gameplay options under "Compass"
[*]Keena's base acceleration has been increased leading to snappier movement
[*]Projectiles are slightly faster by default
[*]The new "Apollo" trial is in the game world, completing this trial gives you a divine gem that further increases your projectile speed
[*]Base attacks can now be cancelled by dashing or using your selected ability
[*]Gui improvement stage 2 : Stat increase screen has been improved
[*]All meters interpolate smoothly
[*]A issue with portraits disappearing has been fixed
[*]Enemies have a new command that returns them to the center of the arena if they leave the boundaries
[*]A new battle-end effect that zooms in on Keena
[*]Hitstop effect when taking damage
[*]The player and enemies now have contrasting outlines to help them stand out against the background.
[/list]

I had to do some clean-up on enemy prefabs that may lead to some odd behavior or animations, this is known and will be fixed soon when I revamp all the enemies. I'll be tackling that in 3 stages, starting with weak, early game enemies, and so-on.

I'll also be tackling the bosses very soon, at least 2 per update, as many need sound effects and other important elements to be considered final. 

-DevDre

notes.title: Update to version 0.8.101
notes.content:
The updates for gameplay and combat improvements soldier on, these are substantial changes to the game that take a bit more time than the previous milestone so they will take a little longer than usual.

I also have plans to address the early game, as I've received plenty of feedback about it being too slow and uninteresting. This will be a major focus later on in this milestone, once combat has been addressed.

Shorter change long as various new features and changes were added incidentally in the previous hotfix.

[list]
[*]GUI Remaster Stage 1 : Combatant HUD - First step of the HUD is the HP/Stamina/Special meter

[*]Added 'Discoveries' to the world map, they can give you resources/money/items or be a battle, this is a work in progress and will be expanded upon
[*]Players can now spec into Keena's stats at the end of any battle if she levelled up
[*]Cooldowns for magic now have a meter
[*]Keena's portrait now changes based on her state and HP
[*]Bosses now start with a 'wait' command to give players a few seconds at the start of boss fights
[*]Camera now has 2 bias options 'player' or 'enemy', by default this follows the currently selected enemy or the mouse (if free aim is enabled)
[*]Relevant gameplay option to change the camera bias added
[*]A hit-stop effect was added to the 'break' status, WIP
[*]The perk tree now indicates which abilities the player has already learned
[/list]

notes.title: Update to milestone 1 version 0.8.100
notes.content:
With the main story and main game relatively stable now, after the 0xx series of updates, I'm moving on to core gameplay improvements and combat enhancements in the 1xx series. Originally the NPC update, I've decided to push that back 1 milestone to work on more important gameplay elements to ensure the game is fun to play and provides a smooth experience to the player. With gamepad support coming as well, this series of updates should pretty drastically change how things play and get us closer to the games final vision.

[list]
[*]Dolphin Dash is now set to Left-Shift and functions as both a dash and a sprint, when held down
[*]Relevant tutorial about Dolphin Dash updated.
[*]Deleted boss projectiles when entering a dialogue to prevent damage while speaking.
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed the player to get hit by 1 attack multiple times a frame, dealing far too much damage.
[*]Hair physics for in-game model have been deactivated for now due to crashes
[*]Obsidian Skin skill has been changed to Magma Aura, and provides a significant damage boost, and damages any nearby enemies.
[*]Stamina now gradually increases smoothly
[*]All crafting recipes are now unlocked by default to encourage crafting and testing builds earlier.
[*]Ice Shield now has a higher initial cost, but allows for you to slowly move, instead of being completely immobile.
[*]The Siren Seal's puzzle now has a guide available
[*]Hazard damage for the final area's have been lowered
[*]Debug menus can now be used in Crystal Palace by locking and unlocking cursor
[*]The whirlpool effect for the Arpas boss fight is less intense for visual clarity
[*]A work in progress combat menu has been added, will be improved in further beta-build updates
[*]Stage 1 of the new world map gameplay has been added that replaces the floating cursor.
[*]Siren Song ability can now be charged in combat for a big HP regeneration effect
[*]Purify now has the combat ability of cutting Stun costs in half, making it easier to Stun-Break enemies
[*]A bug that would delete the camera in Mangled Cave level has been fixed
[*]Siren Seals no longer need to be completed perfectly, and allow for a few errors
[/list]

Many more combat and core gameplay improvements are coming.
Thanks so much for your early support, and the suggestions and feedback from the Discord!

-DevDre

notes.title: Update to version 0.8.009
notes.content:
This is the last update of the 'stablility' milestone, regarding the main stories and core gameplay stability and functionality. 

[list]
[*]Minigame's Escape the Shark and Escape the Current have been optimized.
[*]HP Bar no long floats way above enemies
[*]A Stun meter has been added to enemies to indicate how close the player is to stunning.
[*]Healing orbs from damaging enemies is now Story difficulty only, but more likely to happen.
[*]The key items in the Hermes trial have been fixed and are visible
[*]Fixed an issue where HUD would appear on the world map
[*]Meals now have descriptions
[*]Options menu has been expanded, added to the main menu, and is no longer profile dependent.
[*]Removed a broken dialogue option from Azalea
[*]Improved world map cursor movement and snapping
[*]Moved the 'tracker' unlock earlier into the game so optional content could be explored sooner
[*]Mission area's now pulse for visibility
[*]The 'open menu' keybind will now close it as well.
[*]Free Aim targeting has been added to the gameplay options, player can now attack towards their mouse and cast to mouse position.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Zeus trial where the lightning walls wouldn't despawn
[*]Removed Siren Seals from the 'Escape Refinery' mission that would break the event.
[*]Enemy encounters for all relevant trials have been made easier and can be completed earlier in the game.
[*]Homing gem now works with free aim targeting
[*]'Stun' now halts any enemy actions, even in mid-action
[*]"F to Interact" now has a colored border for visibility
[*]Wake now operates like a normal shop, and sells all ingredients.
[*]Crystal Palace now has a 3D map that slowly rotates, with an indicator for which room you are in
[*]Crystal Palace map now allows for fast travel
[*]Fixed a bug where entering the crystal palace while entering combat would soft-lock the game
[*]Intermediate alchemy recipes are now unlocked by default
[*]A bug where the ice shield was massive and blocked the camera has been fixed
[*]I-frames for Dolphin Dash have been slightly increased
[*][b]WIP [/b]sprint for dolphin dash by holding down right-click
[*]Dolphin Dash is slightly faster
[*]Changed Stamina values to accommodate sprinting
[*]3rd person controls switched to WASD
[*]Players can now interact with checkpoints to save or recall to palace
[*]Players can now recall to the palace from the world map
[*][b]WIP [/b]Journal added to the game
[*]Keena's base attack is now smoother, an arbitrary delay was removed
[*]A game over screen has been added
[*]A death animation has been added
[/list]

A huge thanks to our Discord members for helping me make Miuratale as good as it can be.
With this update done we move on to the NPC milestones in 0.8.1xx where side quests, challenges, and dialogue will be added.

Stability updates will be a constant, that won't change, but priority is shifting towards getting the unfinished content working so we can get closer to the finish line. 

-DevDre

[*]Shell phone now added to dialogue where relevant

[*]Stun status for enemies now lasts longer
[*]Added Azalea to the palace map markers
[*]Map markers switched from icons to text in palace
[*]Midaher staring down while swimming fixed
[*]Keena's 3rd person swim animation has been improved
[*]Speed potions are now in the game, can be found in a few places and can be crafted
[*]3rd person camera now has collision with environment and has been tweaked to be more responsive
[/list]

The first big milestone 0.8.1xx is coming soon, and will be improving on NPC's, and side content adding enrichment to the game world!

Hope you all enjoy the game, as plenty more is coming!

-DevDre

notes.title: Miuratale enters Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After four years of development Miuratale is finally ready to enter Early Access! Start your journey as Keena, the Miura red-tail mermaid, as she enters the depths of mythology and adventure!

[h2]What’s in Early Access?[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fully playable core experience – Explore the Aegean sea, discover ancient secrets, and customize your Trident Warrior to take the fight to the return of a dark, evil force!
[*]An expansive RPG system – Whether it's through cooking meals, brewing potions, or crafting equipment, Keena's stats and strengths are in your hands.
[*]A deep and detailed story – Meet a diverse cast of characters from all walks of life as Keena discovers her own potential and uncovers the secrets that lay deep in the ocean.
[/list]

[h2]What’s Coming Next?[/h2]

[list]
[*]Expanded story – The Early Access starts the journey, but it's only the beginning! We have hours and hours more story to bring to you in free updates!
[*]More gameplay activities – From minigame's to side-quests and optional gameplay challenges, expect to dive even deeper into the life of mermaids and their way of life!
[*]Unlocked combat system – We have a lot of exciting improvements and additions to the combat system coming to challenge and intrigue ARPG fans.
[*]Polish – Our priority is for Miuratale to leave Early Access as a very highly polished and optimized game by squashing bugs and balancing our game with your help and feedback!
[/list]

[h2]Join the Community![/h2]

We need your help moving forward! Your feedback and suggestions will help create the ultimate mermaid game!

Share your feedback, ideas, and favorite moments with us on discord, the Steam forums, or social media.

Website and Roadmap : [url=https://carrionwave.com/]https://carrionwave.com/[/url]

Discord : [url=https://discord.com/invite/WrpRKfS9sN]https://discord.com/invite/WrpRKfS9sN[/url]

Bluesky : [url=https://bsky.app/profile/carrionwave.bsky.social]https://bsky.app/profile/carrionwave.bsky.social[/url]

-DevDre

notes.title: Delay and Update
notes.content:
[h1]Miuratale Update![/h1]

The alpha build is in progress! It's been a lot of work, and the game's evolved significantly since we started this project years ago. Right now, our script has several thousand lines of dialogue! The first prototype from 2 years ago took just an hour to complete, which led us to revamp the script and game, shifting from Metroidvania to RPG. Now, the dialogue alone for the main story takes 4 hours to go through.

We've got about 50 levels, ranging from small caves to massive, 3D cruise ships you can explore inside and out. Plus, we have 50 different enemies and 14 bosses!

All this shows how much the game has grown, but we’re done! No more expanding, just polishing and fixing bugs from here on out.

Here’s what’s coming up...

[list]
[*]First, we're planning a free demo set halfway through the game to give players a taste of combat, exploration, and optional side content!
[*]There won’t be early access. This is really important to me and won't change. We stand by our design choices, and Miuratale has been patiently and carefully crafted, tested, and built to provide the best experience possible. We want new players to get the complete, polished experience right from the start.
[*]And finally, we’ll also have a free major update post-release that will expand on the story, world map, and combat!
[/list]

I hope you understand the delay. I don’t want to release this game until it’s fully finished, and while I think it’ll be done this year, it won't be [i]finished[/i].

To wrap up, I wanted to share a work-in-progress picture of the game's Hub area! The Crystal Palace is one of several areas you can fully explore in 3D using simplified mouse controls and is home to the game's side content!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841837/5ebecb1d4ed09be83df1a3326b09e51d459832a3.jpg[/img]

Also, for those who want more updates, please follow us on IndieDB : [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/miuratale]https://www.indiedb.com/games/miuratale[/url]

Thank you for reading,

DevDre
Carrionwave
